name: aurora-text
blurb: Text fills with a multi-color gradient that shifts and cycles through aurora-like colors.
description: Renders text with an animated background gradient that sweeps continuously, cycling through multiple color stops. Animation speed is configurable.
use_when: A hero heading or inline accent wants a vibrant, multi-color gradient effect that feels organic.
avoid_when: When text must have a corporate or professional single-color appearance.
a11y: Text content is in sr-only; animated visual is aria-hidden.
